title: company_member
_what: ⛔ SNG-658 §2 — ONE ENTRY IN `character.company`: somebody who travels with you, or who did. ⚠️ Departure is a STATUS, NOT A DELETE (SNG-355): a member who left keeps their row with `leftDay` set, because somebody you travelled with for twenty days should be remembered as having left rather than erased.
_derivedFrom: The live saves, 2026-09-26; each field's description says how often it is present.

^_._what: a note or a provenance stamp

npcId.description: 100% — ⛔ the id of a PERSON RECORD. CCODE-514: a join now resolves through `findExistingNpc` and mints a record when nobody answers, because 3 of 7 members across the saves pointed at nobody — no crafts in a fight, no bond, no face.

roles.description: 100% — ally · trainer · liaison, and they STACK. `partner` is never here: it is derived from the bond.

teaches.description: 100% (null on all of them today) — the tradition they teach, when they hold the trainer role.

liaisonFor.description: 100% (null today) — the people they represent, when they hold the liaison role.

joinedDay.description: 100% — the day they threw in with you.

leftDay.description: 33% — the day they stopped travelling with you. ⚠️ NOT grounds to lose a keeper's post (CCODE-514): appointing somebody keeper is a reason they stop walking beside you.

departedWhy.description: 33% — one line on why they went.
